name: 共有方法を確認する招待コード画面
prompt:
Correct the attached v001 full Japanese invite-code screen against the native 390 × 704 preview. Keep the same exact wording and a flat white screen. The hyperlink must remain blue and the reset action green.

In v001, the card/avatar/title cluster is about 7-10 px too high and the card is slightly too large. Set the card to x=30,y=148,w=330,h=338, thin #E8ECE9 border, 12 px corners. Set the avatar to x=170,y=120,w=50,h=50. Keep the title 「地域のなかま」 at x=46,y=190 and caption 「グループの招待コード・見本」 at x=46,y=226, with the native Meiryo Bold 20 px and Regular 12 px sizes. Keep the exact QR at x=108,y=270,w=174,h=174.

The privacy paragraph in v001 is too large. Reduce it by about 15% to match the native Meiryo Regular 12 px, preserving these exact three lines centered at x=30,y=528,w=330,h=48:
このコードを共有すると、受け取った人が
グループに参加できます。招待したい相手に
だけ共有してください。

Keep 「コードの共有について」 at x=30,y=598 in bold 12 px blue #1976D2 as the actual hyperlink. Keep 「招待コードをリセット」 at x=30,y=642 in Regular 14 px forest green #047857 as the separate reset operation. Do not color anything else blue.

Replace the QR and the thin line artifact above it with the exact attached native QR-area crop at its original position, including its white margin. Do not regenerate or alter the QR pattern. Keep the header 「招待コード」 dark and the outlined share icon green. Do not add a device frame, English copy, portraits, URLs, extra text or decoration.
reviewNotes: v002 keeps only コードの共有について blue #1976D2, resets green, and removes the QR line with an exact native patch. Remaining offsets after two attempts: card bottom ~14px high, body ~19px high and link ~11px high; avatar/title/caption 2-3px high. Keep needs-correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
